operation_text: Harvest and thresh chickpea only after pods are hard; do not harvest while the crop is wet.
conditions_text: Only when hard pods and crop dryness are actually observed.
source_quote: हरभरा पीक ११० ते १२० दिवसांमध्ये तयार होते. पीक ओलसर असताना काढणी करू नये. घाटे कडक झाल्यानंतर मग हरभऱ्याची काढणी करून मळणी करावी.
temporal_interpretation: Maharashtra crop technical reference; not a lot-level observation.

operation_text: Harvest maize when the husk cover has dried and turned brown; shell within the cited moisture range.
method_or_parameter: The cited ICAR reference gives a 15–20% shelling moisture range.
conditions_text: Only after observing husk condition and measuring grain moisture; neither is present in the scenario.
source_quote: Maize is ready for harvesting even when the stacks and leaves are somewhat green, but the husk cover has dried and turned brown. Shell Maize when the moisture content ranges between 15-20%.
temporal_interpretation: National crop technical reference; not a district-week advisory or lot-level observation.

operation_text: Dry maize ears after harvest before the next handling step.
method_or_parameter: The cited ICAR reference says ears should preferably be dried for 3–4 days after harvest.
conditions_text: Only after actual harvest; local drying conditions and lot moisture remain unobserved.
source_quote: The Maize ears should preferably be dried for 3-4 days after harvesting to improve grain recoveries and reduce breakage losses.
temporal_interpretation: National crop technical reference; not a district-week advisory or lot-level observation.

operation_text: Harvest at proper maturity and variety-wise; avoid night harvesting.
conditions_text: Use only when the rice crop's proper variety-specific maturity is actually observed.
source_title: Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab — Kharif 2026
source_quote: Harvesting should be done at proper maturity and variety-wise. Avoid harvesting during night.
temporal_interpretation: Punjab crop technical reference; not a lot-level observation.

operation_text: Dry the harvested produce well before storage; keep produce intended for storage in appropriate bins.
method_or_parameter: The cited Punjab package states an optimum paddy storage moisture content of 12%.
conditions_text: Only after harvest and a lot-specific moisture/quality check; this does not establish the actual lot moisture.
source_title: Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab — Kharif 2026
source_quote: Dry the produce well and store separately in disinfested bins. The produce kept for home use should be dried thoroughly in the sun for about a week and stored in bins or kept in a heap inside the room. The optimum moisture content for storage is 12 per cent.
temporal_interpretation: Punjab crop technical reference; not a lot-level observation.

operation_text: Harvest soybean when 90% of pods have changed colour to yellow.
conditions_text: Only when the 90% yellow-pod maturity condition is actually observed.
source_title: Improved Technologies and Recommendations for Maximizing Soybean Productivity
source_quote: When 90% of the pods changes its color to yellow, it is the right indication to go for harvesting.
temporal_interpretation: Soybean technical reference; not a lot-level observation.

operation_text: Use the cited threshing speed to reduce mechanical damage when threshing soybean.
conditions_text: Only after harvest and when the actual threshing system is known.
source_title: Improved Technologies and Recommendations for Maximizing Soybean Productivity
source_quote: To maintain viability of seed and to avoid loss/mechanical damage, threshing should be done at 350-400 rpm.
temporal_interpretation: Soybean technical reference; not a lot-level observation.

operation_text: Sun-dry harvested soybean before threshing; if threshing is delayed, protect it from rain.
conditions_text: Only after actual harvest and with documented drying/storage conditions.
source_title: ICAR-IISR weekly soybean advisory, 25 Sep–01 Oct 2023
source_quote: The harvested crop must be threshed after sun drying. If the threshing is to be done later, it should be stored at safe place protecting from rains.
temporal_interpretation: Dated soybean advisory; the handling quotation remains conditional on actual harvest and lot conditions.

operation_text: Match tomato harvest maturity to the intended market and transport distance.
method_or_parameter: The cited TNAU source distinguishes firm mature-green fruit for distant shipping from turning-pink/half-ripe fruit for fresh consumption.
conditions_text: Only after observing fruit maturity and knowing the intended market; neither is in the scenario.
source_title: TNAU tomato harvesting and post-harvest techniques
source_quote: Generally, firm mature green fruits are best suited for shipping or distant marketing. For fresh consumption, tomatoes are harvested at the turning pink or half ripe stage.
temporal_interpretation: Tamil Nadu tomato technical reference; not a lot-level observation.

operation_text: Remove damaged, rotten, and cracked tomatoes before grading sound fruit.
conditions_text: Only after a harvested lot is available for physical inspection.
source_title: TNAU tomato harvesting and post-harvest techniques
source_quote: Damaged, rotten and cracked fruit are removed. Healthy, attractive, clean and bright fruits are preferred.
temporal_interpretation: Tamil Nadu tomato technical reference; not a lot-level observation.

operation_text: Use packing that protects tomatoes from crushing and permits air circulation.
method_or_parameter: The cited source describes plastic crates for local markets and rigid packing that protects fruit while allowing circulation.
conditions_text: Only after lot grade, destination, pack format, and transport arrangement are known.
source_title: TNAU tomato harvesting and post-harvest techniques
source_quote: Plastic crates are more convenient for handling since they can be stacked one above the other. The contoured rim keeps the product safe and allows sufficient air circulation. The packing should be rigid enough to protect the fruits from being crushed.
temporal_interpretation: Tamil Nadu tomato technical reference; not a lot-level observation.

operation_text: Use the cited storage-temperature guidance only after maturity and cold-chain feasibility are known.
method_or_parameter: The cited TNAU source gives 12–15°C as an ideal storage range and 13°C with 90–95% relative humidity to slow ripening.
conditions_text: Only for a harvested lot with observed maturity and verified facility temperature/humidity capability.
source_title: TNAU tomato harvesting and post-harvest techniques
source_quote: Temperature between 12–15 oC is ideal for storage. A temperature of 13 oC and 90–95% relative humidity is recommended to slow down ripening.
temporal_interpretation: Tamil Nadu tomato technical reference; not a lot-level observation.

operation_text: Harvest and thresh wheat as soon as it is fully ripe to avoid shattering losses.
conditions_text: Only when full wheat maturity is actually observed.
source_title: Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab — Rabi 2025–26
source_quote: Harvest and thresh wheat as soon as fully ripe, to avoid grain shattering. Delayed harvesting results in high grain losses.
temporal_interpretation: Punjab crop technical reference; not a lot-level observation.

operation_text: Dry grain before storage when its moisture exceeds the cited threshold.
method_or_parameter: The cited Punjab package gives a 10% grain-moisture threshold.
conditions_text: Only after a lot-specific moisture measurement; the benchmark does not contain one.
source_title: Package of Practices for Crops of Punjab — Rabi 2025–26
source_quote: In case the grain contains more than 10 per cent moisture, it should be dried before storing, otherwise it would be spoiled by moulds and excessive heat that develops during storage.
temporal_interpretation: Punjab crop technical reference; not a lot-level observation.
